title: AI × Math 每日精选
subtitle: 自动推理、形式化证明、数学智能与基础模型。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: AIProver: Agentic Auto-Formalization of Mathematical Research via Certificate-Driven Evolving Harness
items.abstract_or_text: Proof auto-formalization translates natural-language (NL) theorems and proofs into a formal language (FL) such as Lean, enabling mechanical verification. Despite rapid progress, research-level proofs often depend on concepts missing from leading proof assistant libraries (e.g., Lean's Mathlib), and successful compilation does not guarantee that a translation preserves the theorem's meaning or the proof's reasoning. Furthermore, aligned NL-FL training data are scarce, and leading agents often rely on costly frontier models and manually engineered harnesses. To address the above issues, we present AIProver, an agentic framework for autonomous proof auto-formalization and proof synthesis (AFPS) that jointly post-trains a 119B open-weight language model and evolves its agentic, tool-calling harness with HarnessEvolve. Verifiers assess type correctness, proof completeness, and semantic correctness, returning rewards and diagnostic certificates that drive model fine-tuning and alternating reinforcement learning via symbolic feedback and HarnessEvolve, a certificate-driven evolutionary search over the whole harness control flow that re-tailors the harness to the updated model. For research-level training and evaluation, we introduce LoCoBench, 58.9k instances from Mathlib, CSLib, Mizar Math Library, and a bounded-arithmetic textbook, with a 771-instance validation split whose theorem-proof pairs have no public Lean formalization. Against 39 frameworks spanning AFPS agents, frontier LLMs, and coding agents, AIProver lifts pass@4 semantic correctness over its Leanstral-1.5 base from 15.7% to 36.7% and outperforms every other open-weight system and Aristotle. As a Claude Code and Codex skill, it lifts their semantic correctness from 41.9% and 34.1% to 79.8% and 62.4%, respectively. Further, it is also 24% cheaper than Numina-Lean-Agent, pushing the accuracy-cost frontier of research-level AFPS.
items.summary_zh: AIProver 将 119B 开放权重模型、证书驱动验证和 HarnessEvolve 结合，用于研究级证明自动形式化与证明合成；LoCoBench 和语义正确性指标提供了较清晰的外部评测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作同时检验类型正确性、证明完整性和语义正确性，避免把“成功编译”直接等同于数学正确；公开的 771 项无 Lean 形式化验证集也提高了结果的可检验性。
tags: 证明助手与自动形式化
items.category: 证明助手与自动形式化
items.abstract_zh: 证明自动形式化将自然语言（NL）定理和证明转换为 Lean 等形式语言（FL），从而实现机械验证。尽管进展迅速，研究级证明往往依赖领先证明助手库中缺失的概念（例如 Lean 的 Mathlib），而成功编译也不能保证翻译保留了定理含义或证明推理。此外，对齐的 NL-FL 训练数据稀缺，领先智能体常依赖昂贵的前沿模型和手工设计的 harness。为解决这些问题，我们提出 AIProver：一个用于自主证明自动形式化和证明合成（AFPS）的智能体框架，它联合后训练一个 119B 开放权重语言模型，并利用 HarnessEvolve 演化其智能体工具调用 harness。验证器评估类型正确性、证明完整性和语义正确性，返回奖励与诊断证书，驱动模型微调，并通过符号反馈和 HarnessEvolve 交替进行强化学习；HarnessEvolve 是一种由证书驱动、在整个 harness 控制流上进行的演化搜索，会针对更新后的模型重新定制 harness。针对研究级训练和评测，我们引入 LoCoBench：包含来自 Mathlib、CSLib、Mizar Math Library 和一本有界算术教材的 58.9k 个实例，其中 771 个实例的验证集里的定理—证明对没有公开 Lean 形式化。与涵盖 AFPS 智能体、前沿 LLM 和编程智能体的 39 个框架比较，AIProver 将 Leanstral-1.5 基线的 pass@4 语义正确性从 15.7% 提升到 36.7%，并超过其他所有开放权重系统和 Aristotle。作为 Claude Code 和 Codex 技能，它分别将二者的语义正确性从 41.9% 和 34.1% 提升到 79.8% 和 62.4%。此外，它比 Numina-Lean-Agent 便宜 24%，推进了研究级 AFPS 的准确率—成本前沿。
items.author_line: Prithwish Jana, Viet Bach Hoang, Logan Luna, Viresh Pati, Akash Singirikonda, Cy Xie, Lisa Carbone, Wuyang Chen, Walter Moreira, Joe Stubbs, Sriram Vishwanath, Vijay Ganesh

items.title: When Debate Helps: Proposal Supply and Verification-Aware Readout in Multi-Agent Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Multi-agent debate can improve reasoning, yet often fails to beat simple majority voting. We argue that successful debate requires two distinct mechanisms: proposal supply must surface a correct answer, and readout must identify that answer when voting misses it. We formalize the first requirement through recoverable headroom, which measures cases where a correct proposal is available but the majority answer is wrong. For the second, we develop Latent Verification Debate (LVD), an accounting model in which candidate proposals receive answer-specific verification evidence before final generation. Controlled fixed-proposal interventions estimate this latent effect in equivalent peer-support units and show that correct evidence changes answer probabilities and generated decisions while proposal supply remains fixed. To improve proposal supply, we construct societies from neural-thicket agents using labeled and label-free coverage objectives. Across two backbones and matched-budget reasoning benchmarks, coverage-selected societies increase complementary proposal supply and improve aggregate accuracy in repeated stochastic evaluations. Round-level controls further show that interaction provides gains beyond applying the same finalizer directly to the initial proposals. These results identify proposal coverage and truth-sensitive evidence use as complementary conditions for debate to outperform voting. Code is available at https://github.com/Wang-ML-Lab/when-debate-helps.
items.summary_zh: 该工作把多智能体辩论拆成“提出正确候选”和“识别正确候选”两个环节，提出 recoverable headroom 与 Latent Verification Debate（LVD），并在匹配预算下进行控制实验。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它没有把多数投票准确率当作辩论有效性的唯一解释，而是用固定提案干预和轮次控制区分提案覆盖与验证读出，评测设计较具可诊断性。
items.abstract_zh: 多智能体辩论可以改进推理，但往往无法超过简单多数投票。我们认为，成功的辩论需要两个不同机制：提案供给必须呈现正确答案，而读出机制必须在投票失效时识别该答案。我们通过 recoverable headroom 对第一个要求进行形式化，它衡量的是正确提案已经出现但多数答案错误的情形。针对第二个要求，我们提出 Latent Verification Debate（LVD），这是一个记账模型：候选提案在最终生成前获得针对答案的验证证据。受控的固定提案干预以等价的同伴支持单位估计这一潜在效应，并显示正确证据会改变答案概率和生成决策，同时提案供给保持不变。为改进提案供给，我们基于带标签和无标签的覆盖目标，从 neural-thicket 智能体构造 societies。在两个骨干模型和预算匹配的推理基准上，按覆盖率选择的 societies 增加了互补提案供给，并在重复随机评测中提升了总体准确率。轮次控制还表明，交互本身带来的收益超过了直接对初始提案应用同一个 finalizer 的收益。这些结果表明，提案覆盖与对真值敏感的证据使用，是辩论优于投票的互补条件。代码见 https://github.com/Wang-ML-Lab/when-debate-helps。
items.author_line: Zihao Zhao, Tunyu Zhang, Haizhou Shi, Yusong Zhao, Xinxi Zhang, Hao Wang

items.title: Symbolic Search Is Not Exhausted: Persistent Proof-Space Exploration in Lean4
items.abstract_or_text: Formal theorem proving increasingly combines learned semantic guidance with verified symbolic execution. The quality of the symbolic search substrate therefore determines how much useful mathematical structure can be accumulated, reused, and exposed under a finite inference budget. We introduce ViaLean, a Lean4 prover that organizes symbolic reasoning as bounded exploration of a persistent proof-state graph. Its search preserves coverage across complementary reasoning modes, merges semantically equivalent goals, retains verified intermediate structure, and observes short symbolic futures before committing to a transition. On the complete miniF2F test split, the model-free configuration solves 122/244 problems (50.0% pass@1). Historical and recent symbolic reference points range from Lean's earlier tidy search to modern grind and SMT-backed verification, showing that proof-space organization remains a substantial source of capability. The same persistent state also provides a natural interface for neural--symbolic agents: neural reasoning can operate over verified regions and intermediate objects while Lean continuously expands and validates the local proof space.
items.summary_zh: ViaLean 在 Lean4 中维护持久化证明状态图，合并语义等价目标并保留已验证中间结构；模型无关配置在完整 miniF2F 测试集上达到 122/244 的 pass@1。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果给出明确、可复核的形式化证明成功数，并说明仅改进符号搜索组织也能带来能力增益，不依赖对模型数学能力的夸大表述。
items.abstract_zh: 形式化定理证明日益结合学习到的语义引导与经过验证的符号执行。因此，符号搜索底座的质量决定了在有限推理预算下能够积累、复用和暴露多少有用的数学结构。我们提出 ViaLean，一个 Lean4 证明器，它将符号推理组织为对持久化证明状态图的有界探索。其搜索在互补的推理模式之间保持覆盖率，合并语义等价的目标，保留已验证的中间结构，并在提交转移前观察短期的符号未来。在完整的 miniF2F 测试划分上，模型无关配置解决了 122/244 个问题（50.0% pass@1）。历史和近期的符号参考点从 Lean 早期的 tidy search 到现代 grind 和基于 SMT 的验证不等，表明证明空间组织仍是能力的重要来源。同一持久化状态也为神经—符号智能体提供了自然接口：神经推理可以在已验证区域和中间对象上运行，而 Lean 持续扩展并验证局部证明空间。

items.title: From Transformers to Weighted Automata: Towards the Verification of Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical settings, yet their black-box nature makes it difficult to provide formal guaranties about their behavior. Existing verification approaches rely primarily on empirical probing and testing, leaving open the question of how to reason rigorously about general-purpose trans- former architectures. In this work, we establish a principled bridge between transformers and weighted automata, a classical model from formal language theory. This connection enables us to transfer verification tools from automata the- ory to the analysis of LLMs. Our contributions are twofold: First, we develop a formal correspondence between transformer architectures and weighted automata over reals, showing how distributional properties of LLMs can be captured within this framework. Second, we introduce an identity testing algorithm for weighted automata that provides a statis- tical method for distinguishing whether two stochastic models define the same distribution up to a tolerance threshold. This work provides the first formal bridge between modern neural se- quence models and classical automata theory, clarifying both the poten- tial and the computational challenges for rigorous LLM verification.
items.summary_zh: 论文建立 Transformer 与加权自动机之间的形式对应，并给出用于判断两个随机模型分布是否在容差内相同的加权自动机 identity testing 算法。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是理论性较强的验证框架：它把 Transformer 的分布性质置于经典形式语言工具可处理的对象中，同时明确指出严格验证面临的计算挑战。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地部署在安全关键场景中，但其黑盒性质使得对其行为提供形式保证变得困难。现有验证方法主要依赖经验探测和测试，如何严格推理通用 Transformer 架构仍是开放问题。在这项工作中，我们建立了 Transformer 与形式语言理论中的经典模型——加权自动机——之间的原则性桥梁。该联系使我们能够把自动机理论中的验证工具迁移到 LLM 分析中。我们的贡献有两点：第一，我们建立了 Transformer 架构与实数上的加权自动机之间的形式对应，说明如何在这一框架中刻画 LLM 的分布性质。第二，我们为加权自动机引入一种 identity testing 算法，用于统计地区分两个随机模型是否在容差阈值内定义相同的分布。这项工作首次在现代神经序列模型与经典自动机理论之间建立形式桥梁，阐明了严格 LLM 验证的潜力与计算挑战。
items.author_line: Smayan Agarwal, Aslah Ahmad Faizi, Shobhit Singh, Aalok Thakkar

items.title: Can Language Models Learn to Reject Their Own Bad Reasoning Steps?
items.abstract_or_text: Verifier-guided decoding can prevent harmful reasoning steps from contaminating subsequent generation, but typically relies on an external learned verifier. We ask whether a language model can instead reject its own bad reasoning steps. We define a prefix's recoverability as the probability that the frozen generator can complete it correctly. Diagnostics show that adjacent recoverability changes are often difficult to resolve with practical Monte Carlo budgets, while same-prefix candidates exhibit a sparse low-recoverability tail. We introduce Self-Step Rejection (SSR), which trains a lightweight LoRA acceptance gate on the generator backbone while keeping the base model frozen. SSR uses confidence-qualified first-passage supervision: steps before the first resolved crossing of a root-relative recoverability barrier are accepted, the crossing step is rejected, and unresolved steps and suffixes are excluded. Training combines pointwise classification, same-prefix pairwise learning, and group-relative policy refinement using final-answer correctness. At inference, SSR accepts candidates or resamples from the unchanged prefix under rejection budgets, without an external learned verifier. Across three reasoning models and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SSR improves macro-average accuracy over single-pass decoding by 5.4--10.1 points using 1.21--1.40x as many generated tokens, and achieves the highest macro-average accuracy among evaluated step-level methods. Full-solution scaling methods require 4.47--8.27x the single-pass token cost for comparable performance.
items.summary_zh: Self-Step Rejection（SSR）训练轻量级 LoRA 接受门，在不改变基础生成器的情况下拒绝低可恢复性推理步骤；三个推理模型、五个数学基准上的宏平均准确率提升 5.4–10.1 个百分点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法以可恢复性和首个越界点构造监督，并报告生成 token 成本与全解扩展方法的对比，任务、评测和代价指标都较清晰。
items.abstract_zh: 验证器引导的解码可以防止有害推理步骤污染后续生成，但通常依赖外部学习到的验证器。我们研究语言模型能否拒绝自身不良推理步骤。我们将前缀的可恢复性定义为冻结生成器正确完成该前缀的概率。诊断表明，相邻前缀的可恢复性变化通常难以用实际的蒙特卡洛预算可靠判定，而相同前缀的候选中存在稀疏的低可恢复性尾部。我们提出 Self-Step Rejection（SSR）：在冻结基础模型的同时，在生成器骨干上训练一个轻量级 LoRA 接受门。SSR 使用带置信度限定的首次穿越监督：在相对于根前缀的可恢复性屏障首次得到解析之前的步骤被接受，穿越该屏障的步骤被拒绝，未解析的步骤和后缀被排除。训练结合逐点分类、相同前缀的成对学习，以及使用最终答案正确性的组相对策略优化。推理时，SSR 在不改变生成器的情况下，在拒绝预算内接受候选或从未改变的前缀重新采样。在三个推理模型和五个数学推理基准上，与单次解码相比，SSR 以 1.21–1.40 倍的生成 token 数将宏平均准确率提高 5.4–10.1 个百分点，并在所评估的逐步方法中取得最高宏平均准确率。全解扩展方法要达到相当性能，需要单次通过 token 成本的 4.47–8.27 倍。
items.author_line: Siheng Xiong, Xiaoze Liu, Yiqiao Jin, Xiaoqian Wang, Jing Gao

items.title: Dense Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning in a Unified Geometry State
items.abstract_or_text: Geometry reasoning is naturally stateful: solving a problem repeatedly alternates between structural proposals and exact deductions. We formulate this process as dense neural-symbolic coupling, in which neural guidance and symbolic execution share a typed state and communicate through executable actions at every search step. Neural proposals contribute theorem instances, constructions, and algebraic bridges; the symbolic runtime applies registered rules, propagates exact constraints, and records provenance. A nested controller allocates computation first between neural and symbolic proposal sources and then among admitted actions. We instantiate the framework in OmniGeo, a single solver for plane, analytic, and solid geometry. With Claude Sonnet 4.6, OmniGeo reaches 94.2%, 88.5%, and 89.8% on FormalGeo7K, Conic10K, and SolidFGeo, respectively (90.8% macro average), and solves 21/30 IMO-AG-30 problems.
items.summary_zh: OmniGeo 让神经提案与符号执行共享带类型状态，并在每一步通过可执行动作耦合；在 FormalGeo7K、Conic10K、SolidFGeo 上报告 94.2%、88.5%、89.8%，并解决 30 道 IMO-AG-30 题中的 21 道。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 几何任务中的结构提案、精确演绎、约束传播和来源记录均被纳入统一状态，结果既有标准数据集分数，也有 IMO-AG-30 的可核验题数。
items.abstract_zh: 几何推理天然具有状态性：解决一个问题需要在结构提案与精确演绎之间反复交替。我们将这一过程表述为稠密神经—符号耦合，其中神经引导和符号执行共享带类型的状态，并在每个搜索步骤通过可执行动作通信。神经提案贡献定理实例、构造和代数桥接；符号运行时应用已注册规则、传播精确约束并记录来源。一个嵌套控制器先在神经和符号提案源之间分配计算，再在获准动作之间分配计算。我们在 OmniGeo 中实例化这一框架，构建了一个统一的平面、解析和立体几何求解器。使用 Claude Sonnet 4.6 时，OmniGeo 在 FormalGeo7K、Conic10K 和 SolidFGeo 上分别达到 94.2%、88.5% 和 89.8%（宏平均 90.8%），并解决了 30 道 IMO-AG-30 问题中的 21 道。
items.author_line: Ruoran Xu, Wending Gao, Haoyu Cheng, Xiaoqiang Kang, Qiufeng Wang

items.title: Hierarchical Credit Assignment for RLVR on Fused Gromov-Wasserstein Geometry
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been shown to improve the reasoning capability of large language models (LLMs) across diverse reasoning tasks. However, group-based RLVR methods, such as GRPO, assign a uniform advantage to all tokens within rollouts of the same outcome. While existing works refine credit assignment of GRPO based on local signals such as token locations or entropy, they often fail to capture the global semantic novelty of a reasoning behavior relative to the current policy. In this work, we propose a hierarchical credit assignment approach for group-based RLVR methods, called HarA, which identifies and encourages semantically novel reasoning behaviors during RLVR. HarA represents each sampled rollout as a distribution over the hidden states and locations of tokens, and computes the Fused Gromov-Wasserstein (FGW) barycenters of all rollouts with the same outcome, capturing the internal reasoning patterns in the latent space under the current policy. The semantic novelty of a reasoning element can then be measured by its contribution to the FGW distance between the current rollout and the barycenter. While solving the FGW formulation is expensive, we introduce an anchor-guided linearization that turns it into a Wasserstein formulation solvable via the Sinkhorn algorithm efficiently. By reweighing token-level advantage of group-based RLVR methods based on the novelty signals, HarA highlights novel reasoning behaviors at flexible granularities to encourage fine-grained LLM exploration. Extensive experiments across three group-based RLVR methods show that our plug-and-play method effectively enhances the exploration of LLMs, outperforming existing methods across diverse reasoning benchmarks.
items.summary_zh: HarA 用 Fused Gromov-Wasserstein（FGW）重心衡量同一结果下推理轨迹的语义新颖性，再重加权 RLVR 的 token 级优势，以鼓励细粒度探索。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法把潜在空间中的轨迹差异转化为可计算的信用分配信号，并在三种组式 RLVR 方法和多类推理基准上进行比较。
items.abstract_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已被证明能够在多种推理任务中提升大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。然而，GRPO 等基于组的 RLVR 方法会把同一结果的轨迹中所有 token 分配相同优势。现有工作依据 token 位置或熵等局部信号细化 GRPO 的信用分配，但往往无法捕捉某种推理行为相对于当前策略的全局语义新颖性。在这项工作中，我们提出一种用于组式 RLVR 方法的分层信用分配方法 HarA，它识别并鼓励语义上新颖的推理行为。HarA 将每条采样轨迹表示为 token 隐状态及其位置上的分布，并计算具有相同结果的所有轨迹的 Fused Gromov-Wasserstein（FGW）重心，从而捕捉当前策略在潜在空间中的内部推理模式。随后，可以通过当前轨迹与重心之间 FGW 距离的贡献来衡量某个推理元素的语义新颖性。由于求解 FGW 公式代价昂贵，我们引入锚点引导的线性化，将其转化为可用 Sinkhorn 算法高效求解的 Wasserstein 公式。通过依据新颖性信号重新加权组式 RLVR 方法的 token 级优势，HarA 在灵活粒度上突出新颖推理行为，以鼓励 LLM 进行细粒度探索。在三种组式 RLVR 方法上的大量实验表明，这一可即插即用的方法有效增强了 LLM 的探索，并在多种推理基准上优于现有方法。
items.author_line: Qi Yu, Ruizhong Qiu, Zhichen Zeng, Xuying Ning, Yanjun Zhao, Dongqi Fu, Yinglong Xia, Hong Li, Hanghang Tong

items.title: Viva La Vida: Verification and Accumulation Failures in Multi-Agent Proof Search
items.abstract_or_text: When an agentic prover works on an open problem, there is no proof assistant to fall back on: its verifier and lemma library are ultimately language models judging model outputs. We instrumented such a system end to end and analyzed 51{,}754 traced observations across three full runs (186 hours, \5{,}694). We find three connected failure modes. First, the three-model verifier requires unanimity and treats parse or API failure as non-approval; in 10 of 12 verification events, one member returned no parseable output or an API error, making acceptance arithmetically impossible without surfacing an error. Second, when the ensemble did function, one verifier approved 3 attempts that GPT rejected, each claiming to resolve the open problem; a single-verifier design would therefore have announced a solution three times. Third, because nothing could be approved, every review was a refutation, yet the lemma extractor mines reviews as well as proofs: 24 of 93 lemmas (26\%) were extracted from rejected arguments with their refutational context removed. Taken together, these findings show that without external verification, supervision is itself a critical trust boundary: systems must distinguish abstention from rejection, preserve useful disagreement, and preserve the provenance and polarity of information before it becomes future context.
items.summary_zh: 对一个开放问题多智能体证明器进行端到端审计，发现验证器 API/解析失败、单一验证器误批准，以及从被否定论证抽取引理等累积失效模式。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究不把模型输出当作可靠证明，而是量化验证与知识积累的信任边界，为证明搜索系统区分拒绝、弃权和证据来源提供了可检验警示。
items.abstract_zh: 当智能体证明器处理一个开放问题时，没有证明助手可供依赖：其验证器和引理库最终都是评判模型输出的语言模型。我们对这样一个系统进行了端到端插桩，并分析了三次完整运行中的 51,754 条跟踪观测（186 小时、5,694）。我们发现了三个相互关联的失效模式。第一，三模型验证器要求全体一致，并把解析失败或 API 失败视为未批准；在 12 次验证事件中有 10 次，一名成员没有返回可解析输出或出现 API 错误，使得在不显式报告错误的情况下批准在算术上不可能。第二，当集成验证器正常工作时，有一个验证器批准了 3 次 GPT 拒绝的尝试，每次都声称解决了开放问题；因此，单验证器设计会宣布 3 次解决方案。第三，由于没有任何内容能够获批，每次审查都是反驳，但引理提取器同时从审查和证明中挖掘内容：93 条引理中有 24 条（26%）来自被拒绝的论证，且其反驳语境已被移除。综合来看，这些发现表明，在没有外部验证的情况下，监督本身就是关键的信任边界：系统必须区分弃权与拒绝，保留有用的分歧，并在信息成为未来上下文之前保留其来源和极性。
items.author_line: Benji Xu, Ken Zheng, Noah Han

items.title: Second-Order Problem Solving for Recursive Self-Improvement in Formal Verification
items.abstract_or_text: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) enables agents to iteratively optimize their workflows via execution feedback. However, standard RSI typically operates as a first-order optimizer: it repeatedly patches surface-level parameters in response to immediate failure symptoms, often leading to trial-and-error thrashing without resolving underlying mechanisms. To address this limitation, we introduce SO-RSI, a framework that elevates workflow optimization to a second-order diagnostic inquiry, investigating why failures occur before committing to structural interventions. SO-RSI passively monitors execution traces for three structural anomalies (recurrence, opposing edits, and expectation mismatch) to trigger targeted mechanism investigations. By executing lightweight diagnostic probes and maintaining persistent inquiry memory across RSI rounds, SO-RSI accumulates causal evidence to guide systematic workflow edits rather than parameter patches. Across Lean 4 proof generation and Verus-based verifiable code generation, SO-RSI improves final held-out pass rates over Naive RSI by 21.8 and 25.8 percentage points under matched 24-hour search budgets. Behavioral analyses further confirm that SO-RSI substantially suppresses failure recurrence and eliminates unproductive zero-progress optimization loops.
items.summary_zh: SO-RSI 将递归自我改进从表层参数修补提升为二阶诊断，在 Lean 4 证明生成和 Verus 可验证代码生成上，相比 Naive RSI 的留出集通过率分别提高 21.8 和 25.8 个百分点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 框架明确监测重复、相互对立编辑和预期不匹配三类异常，并在匹配的 24 小时搜索预算下报告留出结果，任务和对照较明确。
items.abstract_zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）使智能体能够通过执行反馈反复优化其工作流。然而，标准 RSI 通常作为一阶优化器运行：它根据即时失败症状反复修补表层参数，往往陷入试错式震荡，而没有解决潜在机制。为克服这一局限，我们提出 SO-RSI，这一框架把工作流优化提升为二阶诊断探究，在实施结构性干预前先调查失败为何发生。SO-RSI 被动监测执行轨迹中的三类结构异常（重复、相互对立的编辑和预期不匹配），以触发有针对性的机制调查。它执行轻量级诊断探针，并在多轮 RSI 之间维护持久化探究记忆，从而积累因果证据，引导系统性的工作流编辑，而不是参数修补。在 Lean 4 证明生成和基于 Verus 的可验证代码生成上，在匹配的 24 小时搜索预算下，SO-RSI 相比 Naive RSI 将最终留出集通过率分别提高 21.8 和 25.8 个百分点。行为分析进一步确认，SO-RSI 大幅抑制了失败复发，并消除了无进展的低效优化循环。
items.author_line: Yuxuan Jiang, Aditya Vempaty, Ashish Jagmohan

items.title: MESH-Harness: Self-Improving Agent Harnesses via Bandit-Guided Compositional Evolution
items.abstract_or_text: An agent harness is the code that organizes context, maintains state, and coordinates tool calls for a language model. We study how to improve the harness under a limited evaluation budget while keeping model weights fixed. Our method, MESH-Harness, organizes each harness into functional modules with explicit role-specific interfaces, allowing alternative implementations of each module to be substituted and recombined. It uses shared module representations and full-covariance LinUCB to score candidate combinations based on predicted performance and exploration value. Mixed-start coordinate ascent selects complete configurations for evaluation without enumerating the combinatorial space. Validation traces then guide local code edits, and the resulting candidates are incorporated into fixed-capacity role-specific pools for subsequent recombination. On text tasks, retrieval-augmented mathematical reasoning, code generation, and interactive scientific tasks, MESH-Harness outperforms Meta-Harness by 5.70, 7.01, 2.00, and 5.00 points, respectively, under matched candidate-evaluation budgets. Iterative harness optimization improves MESH-Harness by 5.63-7.79 points over its first-round configurations. For the reported configurations, aggregate test-time cost is 44.2% lower than that of Meta-Harness, while total cost including search is 14.6% lower. These results show that combining module-level design reuse with feedback-driven compositional search can systematically improve agent harnesses while keeping overall optimization cost under control.
items.summary_zh: MESH-Harness 将智能体 harness 拆成可组合模块，用 full-covariance LinUCB 和混合起点坐标上升搜索配置；在检索增强数学推理等任务上报告相对 Meta-Harness 的准确率提升与成本下降。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把 harness 搜索预算、模块重组、迭代增益和总成本同时纳入评测，可用于区分模型权重能力与运行时编排能力。
items.abstract_zh: 智能体 harness 是组织上下文、维护状态并协调语言模型工具调用的代码。我们研究如何在有限评测预算下改进 harness，同时保持模型权重不变。我们的方法 MESH-Harness 将每个 harness 组织成带有明确角色接口的功能模块，从而可以替换和重组各模块的不同实现。它使用共享的模块表示和 full-covariance LinUCB，根据预测性能与探索价值为候选组合评分。混合起点坐标上升法选择完整配置进行评测，而无需枚举组合空间。随后，验证轨迹引导局部代码编辑，所得候选被纳入固定容量的、按角色划分的池中，以便后续重组。在文本任务、检索增强数学推理、代码生成和交互式科学任务上，在候选评测预算匹配的条件下，MESH-Harness 相比 Meta-Harness 分别提高 5.70、7.01、2.00 和 5.00 个百分点。迭代式 harness 优化使 MESH-Harness 相比其第一轮配置提高 5.63–7.79 个百分点。对于报告的配置，其测试时总成本比 Meta-Harness 低 44.2%，包括搜索在内的总成本低 14.6%。这些结果表明，将模块级设计复用与反馈驱动的组合搜索结合起来，可以在控制总体优化成本的同时系统性改进智能体 harness。
items.author_line: Zhiwei Shang, Yu Huo, Mingrong Gong, An Yan, Zikun Qu, Junhao Dong, Bryan Kian Hsiang Low, Chenglin Wu, Zhongxiang Dai

review.note: 依据候选集中公开摘要与评分，保留 10 项与定理证明、形式化验证、数学推理、证明助手或可检验模型评测直接相关的工作；未将仅有泛化应用而缺乏数学验证证据的条目纳入。
